Asset type: clean reusable full hero stage, landscape 2:1, 1536 x 768 pixels or higher at this same ratio; no interface or typography.

Preserve the scene's silhouette, palette, cinematic blue light, black background, rocky floor and the giant watch's three-quarter pose.

Composition: a black and deep midnight-blue stage filling the entire 2:1 canvas. Keep the left 35 percent and right 15 percent of the frame as dark usable negative space. The giant watch stands on the rough black rock floor at right-center, occupying approximately x=45%-77% and y=6%-95% of the frame. Show its whole blue strap loop and body, standing upright in the same 3/4 pose as input 1. A blue shaft of light falls diagonally from the top-left toward the watch; a cool blue glow blooms behind its lower right edge. Preserve the photographic premium material rendering, tiny surface texture, dark shadows and blue rim highlights from the approved image.

Subject identity: match the actual device in input 2: light periwinkle blue polymer body and silicone strap, darker graphite-gray bezel, rounded rectangular screen, centered circular camera bump interrupting the upper bezel, large ridged crown on the right, lower blue side button with orange accent, long oval strap perforations, small horizontal speaker slot below the screen. Keep the design and proportions recognizable. Use the pose of input 1 rather than input 2's front-on angle. The entire interior display is an empty nearly black glass surface with very subtle reflection; no dog, no fictional content, no time, no letters. The parent will perspective-map the real project video onto this physical screen. Keep screen edges crisp so its four inner corners can be measured.

Remove all baked UI, headline, numbers, logos, navigation, captions, buttons, controls, borders, page panels, layout chrome and the light section below the hero. No text anywhere. The rock and lighting fill edge to edge without card corners or a floating-card shadow. Do not redesign the object or add objects. This is a faithful clean production regeneration of the approved hero stage.
